staticReview: Exact GLB, seven normal and seven clay views. Adult scientist silhouette, sage/cream bob, visible blue-grey eyes, glasses, white coat, charcoal vest/tie and red badge retained.
motionReview: Exact reimport at correct FPS; 50 motion keyframes. Wrist placement and close coat-shell weights repaired; Eat, Gather, Walk, Run, Craft, Give, Wave, Attack and Downed inspected. No ground-plane accessory or substituted organic geometry.
notes: One completed Candidate 1; rejected reconstructions and intermediate rigs retained.
Generated full-body interpretation of two user portraits; trousers, shoes and back are inferred.
28 joints, maximum four influences. Coat and hair secondary bones; rigid facial features and glasses.
CMU 35_01 walking and 09_01 running; original clips and geometry preserved through motion retargeting.
Double-sided coat with repaired spatially continuous skin; this is a skinned garment, not cloth simulation.
Browser confirms exact SHA, 10 clips, normal/half-speed playback from two views, pause/scrub, quarter speed, rotation/zoom/reset and mobile controls. Zero external requests and page errors.
Game integration QA follows adoption; this review does not claim a public deployment or exhibition-PC cutover.
